questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this traffic law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when approaching a railroad crossing. Look and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending ahead. Prepare to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that traffic from the right will be merging into your lane. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road ahead has two curves: first to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or steep downgrade is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter this road or driveway from your current direction. You must turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that the road splits ahead into two directions. You must choose to bear right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a crossroad is ahead. Be ready for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks to tell you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings, and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means you are entering a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions that may not be obvious. This sign warns you that a side road is intersecting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must let them pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Look for a stop line, crosswalk, or intersection to know where to stop. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign means yield. Slow down and be prepared to stop to let other drivers and pedestrians pass. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you an intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. This sign warns you that construction or maintenance work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass is ahead with low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign in yellow with black markings. It warns you that traffic will be merging from the right. Be ready to allow this traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.
